PayU Reports First Operational Profit in FY26

Fintech firm PayU, owned by Prosus, has reported its first-ever operational profit of $18 million for the fiscal year 2026. This achievement was driven by a 13% increase in revenue, reaching $781 million, and a positive EBITDA. The company's growth was supported by its payments and credit businesses, particularly higher-margin products and ecosystem lending.
